description: Runs audit_site on two or three websites and returns the scores side by side, the five category scores per site, the checks the first site fails or only partly passes while another site passes them, the checks where the first site is ahead, and a report link per site. Put the user's own site first. Each site that is not already cached counts as one audit against the free daily limit. A site that cannot be audited is listed with the reason and the others are still compared.

urls.description: Two or three domains, the user's own site first, for example ["mine.com", "rival.com"]

name: compare_sites
title: Compare two or three sites on the audit
